svg.text: On the CN4 cable GND and 3V3 are swapped
compared to the perfboard: follow the LABELS,
not the position of the wires.
On the PCF: A0, A1, A2 all to GND
With the jumper the 5 V ends up on the 3V3.
PCF8574 → relay module (direct, not through the perfboard)
Relay 1 = main 12 V loads, relay 2 = pump.
Buck's USB-C cable cut open: 4 wires.
Rejoin the 4 colour to colour towards the P4;
tap only red (5 V) and black (GND). White/green = data.
The buck powers the P4 through USB-C → CN2.
Relays 1 and 2 → conn 17 plug (12 V loads and pump)
Both COMs to pin 3. NO stays free.
At rest NC is closed: loads and pump
stay ON even with the panel off.
Pin 11 is NOT ground: it needs
its own wire, do not join it to GND.
Two wires per probe, no polarity:
one on row 17, the other on row 18.
